title: Anthony R Probable NDE 9094
content: It was just after dinner. I had been thinking about suicide for weeks because I was not able to find a job. I was feeling down about myself for not contributing to my family. So, I took some pills to end it all. I was unconscious and in the hospital for five days. I remember floating in a void. I could see a little box or window to the physical world. It was a distance away, but I could see my mom sitting to the left of the hospital bed. There were two doctors to the right of my body. I felt peaceful, despite nothing but darkness around me. Yet I didn't feel like I was alone. I don't know how long I was there, but I did have a choice whether I was going to live or die. I could hear myself thinking that I needed to come back to my body. I returned to see the surprised look on the doctors faces, like I wasn't supposed to be there right now. I came back feeling a whole lot better like nothing happened. It was a wild experience that changed me forever. I will never forget that experience. My faith in God became deeper. I no longer fear death and freely live life. Even thought life is tough, it is not worth taking your life. I still wonder what would have happened if I had chosen to stay there. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: August 12 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes. Suicide attempt How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness. It was a real-life changer At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? While I was in the void, when I started back up to the window to the physical world and saw my mom and the doctors standing over my body. Also having the choice to die or live Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. The faces of my mom and the nurses were kind of blurry as I was floating around in the void while getting closer to death Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I couldn't hear what was going on in the hospital room only what was in the void with me I was quite and peaceful but I did hear a voice saying it is your choice to live or die Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Uncertain I feel like that was going to be the next step in the process I feel like I just entered the void and what ever happened next was up to me Did you see any beings in your experience? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm What emotions did you feel during the experience? I felt at peace nothing to worry about Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about myself or others Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Other Christian What is your religion now? Christian- Other Christian Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Just live life and trust God Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I heard a voice I could not identify I had to be God telling me it's my choice Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I sensed their presence During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I'm not really sure but I know God brought me back for a reason During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists Yes Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? Yes My life's trouble were not worth ending it During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes I could feel the sadness and how much my family would miss me What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes I was kinda tuff to explain but it was real How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? The whole thing was significant Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes 2 months Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? Yes Did the questions asked and information that you provided accurately and comprehensively describe your experience? Uncertain A collective of research Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? I value life but I'm ready to go whenever it's my time

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Floating in a void while viewing a small 'box or window' to the physical world (hospital room).

arrival.other_being_detail: He sensed a presence and heard an unidentifiable voice he believed was God.

environment.environment_other_detail: A dark void with a distant small 'box or window' view into the hospital room.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: He decided he 'needed to come back' after being told it was his choice to live or die; he later interpreted it as God bringing him back for a reason and that his troubles were not worth ending his life.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Implied reason/mission: to continue living; he believed God brought him back for a reason and learned not to end his life.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Void experience with a 'window' view into the hospital room.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE/void with view into hospital and a choice to live or die; no reported tunnel, light, or life review.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived a distant small 'box or window' to the physical world while floating in a dark void; could not hear the hospital room but heard a voice in the void saying it was his choice to live or die.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I remember floating in a void. I could see a little box or window to the physical world.”
